name: CE_STMT_BALANCES_INT
description: CE_STMT_BALANCES_INT contains information about statement balance interface.

columns.name: STMT_BALANCE_INT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the statement balance in the interface.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Bank account to which this balance is reported.

columns.name: STATEMENT_HEADER_INT_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to the statement header interface table.

columns.name: BALANCE_CODE
columns.description: Specifies the nature of balance. For example, opening booked balance.

columns.name: ORIG_BALANCE_CODE
columns.description: Balance code reported originally in the data file.

columns.name: BALANCE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Balance amount corresponding to the balance code.

columns.name: BALANCE_CURR
columns.description: Balance currency reported on the bank statement.

columns.name: CREDIT_DEBIT_IND
columns.description: Identifies whether the balance amount included is positive (credit) or negative (debit).

columns.name: CR_LINE_INCL_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the credit line is included or not.

columns.name: CR_LINE_CURR
columns.description: Currency code of the credit line.

columns.name: BALANCE_DATE
columns.description: Date when the balance is reported.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
